question: The Santosh Trophy, introduced in 1941, is named after which notable figure?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sir Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhury**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Santosh Trophy** is a prestigious football tournament in India, established in **1941**.
 
• It is named after **Sir Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhury**, who was the **President of the Indian Football Association (IFA)** at the time of its inception. *Hence, the correct answer is Sir Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhury.*
 
• The trophy was instituted to promote football at the grassroots level and provide a platform for state teams to compete on a national scale.
 
• Sir Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhury was a prominent figure in Indian football, and his contributions to the sport were recognized by naming this tournament after him.
 
• The tournament is contested by state and services teams, showcasing the best football talent across the country.
